title: code_index.change_signature response
description: Tagged result of a signature change. `applied` and `dry_run` carry the per-file edits and every rewritten call site; every other tag is a refusal that wrote nothing, with the blocking locations in `sites` (or `candidates` for `ambiguous` seed lookups) and the reason in `details`.

result.description: `partial`: some files failed to write after every plan passed (see `failed_paths_with_reasons`). `error`: the request cannot apply to this declaration (unknown `from`, a new parameter without `call_value` or `default`, an unchanged list, an unsupported parameter form). `parameter_in_use`: the body still uses a removed parameter. `value_reference`: the function is used as a value. `unsupported_call_site`: a call passes a spread, splat, or an argument count that cannot be remapped. `overrides_present`: the function is a method whose name other declarations share. `ambiguous`: several declarations match the seed, another free function shares the name, or a call by that name cannot reach this declaration.

touched_files.description: One entry per file the change rewrites. Empty on refusals.

warnings.description: Non-blocking notes. Empty today; kept so every code_index refactor shares one envelope.

call_sites_updated.description: Number of call sites rewritten (or planned, on `dry_run`).

sites.description: On `applied`/`dry_run`: every rewritten call site. On a refusal: every blocking location.

parameters_before.description: Each current parameter, excluding the receiver. Present on every result after the declaration was read, refusals included; empty before that.

parameters_after.description: Source text of each parameter in the new header, receiver first. Empty on refusals.

fallback_suggestion.description: Present only on `unsupported_language`: the text-edit path to fall back to.
